'If an item you control has been destroyed this turn, this gets OVERPOWER.' plus a separate Galvanize defence trigger.

WORD FOR WORD THE SOUP UP SENTENCE with overpower in place of go again, and it had word for word the same defect: the clause was hung off ON_DEFEND, which is the OTHER half of the card, so it fired at the wrong time -- and being triggered it left the PRINTED Overpower unconditional, so the attack had overpower whether or not an item had been destroyed. loader.conditional_keywords strips a printed keyword only for a SOURCE_IS_ATTACK-gated static, and that is not go-again-specific: it covers every keyword in _GRANTABLE_KEYWORDS. WHILE_STATIC per CR 6.2.3d. The DESTROYED_THIS_TURN condition was already correct and is kept; Galvanize is untouched.
